name: MessagingGateway
summary: Wraps the messaging calls behind methods stated in the domain's own words, so that only one class in the application knows there is a messaging system at all.

roles.name: MessagingGateway
roles.summary: The class that turns a business call into a message and back. Its methods take domain arguments rather than message properties, which is what lets the rest of the application be tested, read and changed without a broker in sight — and what makes the messaging system replaceable by editing one class.
